summary: The snapshot captures the broad direction of the project reasonably well: Sub-Q2 is the strongest area, Sub-Q3/Sub-Q4 are still exploratory, and the repo generally shows conservative rigor practices with explicit retractions and grading. However, the status snapshot is not accurate enough to be treated as an authoritative completion assessment. It materially overstates Sub-Q1/Phase 0 completeness, uses stale path α blocker status, and contains incorrect code/test inventory data. I also could not live-verify the current test suite because `pytest` cannot start in this read-only environment without a usable temp directory, so the claimed green status remains documentary rather than confirmed.

issues.description: The snapshot says Phase 0/Sub-Q1 is complete with 'MS-EB framework + WLC SDP + seven-family quintuple', but the current repo still documents substantial Sub-Q1 gaps. `docs/PROSPECTUS.md:176-189` requires coverage of the main protocol families plus automatic derivation into the toolchain, while `docs/framework_coverage.md:133-141` still marks F3 SARG04 as `spec_only`, F5 MDI as `partial`, F6 TF as `not_started`/`partial`, and F7 MP-QKD as `out_of_scope`. The code matches that partial state: `qkdx/protocols/mdi.py:159-166` keeps MDI at `partial`, and `qkdx/protocols/pm_qkd.py:10-30` is explicitly a partial shell rather than a full MS-EB implementation.
issues.suggestion: Downgrade Sub-Q1/Phase 0 from 'complete' to something like 'Phase 0 required path complete' or 'partially complete', and list the remaining family-coverage gaps explicitly.

issues.description: The Phase 2/open-blocker status is stale. The snapshot says path α is a '11 sub-gap' item with 'C3 REJECTED', but the referenced proof stack has already moved past that. `docs/proofs/umr_path_alpha_three_lemma_v0_3.md:110-112` says the inventory expanded to 12 sub-gaps, and `docs/proofs/path_alpha_subgap_closure_integration_v0_3.md:27-49` records the 2026-04-26 state as 10/12 sub-gaps with C1+C3 PASS, 2/12 still OPEN, and a C2 signature batch still pending. That means the snapshot is no longer identifying the real blockers accurately.
issues.suggestion: Refresh the path α section from the 2026-04-26 integration report, distinguish OPEN structural gaps from passed-but-awaiting-C2 items, and update the blocker queue accordingly.

issues.description: The code inventory table is factually wrong. `qkdx/protocols/` is reported as 6 completed protocol files, but the tree has 5 protocol modules plus `__init__.py` (`bb84.py`, `efficient_bb84.py`, `mdi.py`, `pm_qkd.py`, `sixstate.py`), and at least `mdi.py` and `pm_qkd.py` self-identify as partial implementations. `qkdx/analytic/` is reported as 2 files, but the repo currently contains 8 analytic modules (`channel.py`, `decoy.py`, `gllp.py`, `mdi_decoy.py`, `pm_qkd.py`, `pm_qkd_decoy.py`, `shor_preskill.py`, `six_state.py`).
issues.suggestion: Regenerate the module table directly from the filesystem and annotate maturity (`covered`/`partial`/`placeholder`) instead of using a blanket completion mark.

issues.description: The test section is inaccurate and incomplete. It claims '79+ tests' and lists only seven test directories, but the current repo also has `tests/test_finite_key/` and `tests/test_protocol/`, while `tests/test_integration/` contains no actual tests. This also conflicts with `docs/PHASE0_REPORT.md:116-127`, which documents 131 passed + 9 skipped during Phase 0. I could not re-run `pytest` in this environment because the read-only sandbox has no usable temporary directory, so the claimed current green status is not live-verified.
issues.suggestion: Separate historical phase-specific pass counts from the current suite inventory, include all present test packages, and only claim 'all green' after rerunning the suite in a writable environment.

issues.description: The Sub-Q4 artifact version is stale. The snapshot records `gap_shape_g4_1.md v0.3`, but `docs/findings/gap_shape_g4_1.md:1-5` and `docs/PHASE_STATUS.md:121-124` already show the current artifact is v0.4. This is a small but clear sign that the snapshot was assembled from unsynchronized source docs.
issues.suggestion: Synchronize version numbers and artifact names against the current repo state before treating the snapshot as authoritative.

round_recommendation: Rebuild the snapshot from current repository artifacts: mark Sub-Q1/Phase 0 as partial rather than complete, refresh path α to the 2026-04-26 12-sub-gap state, regenerate the module/test inventories from the filesystem, and re-run the test suite in a writable environment before resubmitting.
